design.reference: New original deterministic material-modal and seeded-air synthesis. No samples, copied melody, or timbre inherited from rejected v2-v4 cast recipes.
design.gameplay: AscendanceCasterItem latches each press; EquipmentWeaponService.castMagic dispatches weapon.cast.release only after successful bolt spawn. A rapid semi-automatic short-range launch, not charge-up or impact.
design.runtimeHandoff: Use the existing accepted-launch world cue once per successful cast; do not add feedback to cooldown-rejected presses or failed bolt spawns. Select one concept after listening approval. Keep projectile impact separate.
design.revisionRequest: Start the cast design again with three clearly distinct material-and-air concepts; avoid oscillating/chirpy bass woops.
design.comparison: Three alternative concepts, not automatic random variants. Objective loudness is calibrated across this comparison only; subjective listening and game mix remain pending.
design.title: A - Crystal air flick
design.description: A short crystal-facet contact opens a compact air flick. The brief fixed, inharmonic resonance is embedded in the moving air rather than sustained as a musical note.

levelCalibration.method: Uniform gain adjustment within each concept after actual Vorbis measurement; retain different transient shapes and natural crest factors. Peak ceiling remains -6.5 dBFS.
